title: Hardware Functional Verification
description: Advancing methodologies for verifying digital circuits, including AI-based approaches for testbench component generation and simulation-based verification for complex hardware systems.

title: Hardware Design
description: Investigating the use of AI to enhance the quality and efficiency of physical design and electronic design automation (EDA) methodologies.

title: Machine Learning in Hardware Verification
description: Exploring the intersection of AI and hardware verification by developing machine learning-based techniques to strengthen both pre-silicon and post-silicon verification practices.

title: Software Testing
description: Conducting research in automated test generation, mutation testing, and program analysis to improve software quality and reliability across diverse application domains.

title: Agentic AI Systems & Energy Efficiency
description: Developing energy accounting frameworks for multi-step LLM pipelines and autonomous AI agents. Introduces Energy per Successful Goal (EpG) — a goal-level metric that replaces per-inference counting and exposes the true energy cost of agentic workflows involving retries, tool calls, and orchestration overhead.

title: AI Hardware Observability
description: Exposing energy measurement blind spots in edge AI hardware — including NVIDIA's flagship platforms — where SoC integration prevents process-level energy attribution. Establishing hardware observability requirements and calibration standards needed for accurate energy profiling of AI inference workloads.
